item.title: Former SBC President Steve Gaines entering hospice care
item.description: Former Southern Baptist Convention President Steve Gaines has entered hospice care, over two years after he was diagnosed with kidney cancer. #SouthernBaptists #SteveGaines #BellevueBaptist #Tennessee #hospice #SBC #president

item.title: Candace Cameron Bure shares warning about 'friends' after invitation to S&M party: 'Dark and demonic'
item.description: Candace Cameron Bure revealed this week on her podcast that a friend once invited her to an exclusive party but failed to warn her that it was actually an underground S&M party. #CandaceCameronBure #Hollywood #celebrityculture #Christianliving

item.title: Christian employee sues county gov't after being denied religious exemption from pride month
item.description: A Christian civil engineer has filed a lawsuit against a California county after he was denied a religious exemption to work from home while the government office he works at celebrates LGBT pride month. #Batman #LosAngeles #pridemonth #LGBT #religiousfreedom #LibertyCounsel

item.title: False prophecy as a path to riches: Targeting wealthy donors (part 2)
item.description: It rarely gets media attention, but for decades, so-called prophets have targeted wealthy individuals with personalized prophecies for the purpose of obtaining lucrative donations. #falseprophets #prophecies #BennyHinn

item.title: Pastor Jamal Bryant says Target boycott is over but other activists say it’s not
item.description: Megachurch Pastor Jamal Bryant, who once rejected efforts to end a national boycott of retail giant Target over the company’s decision to roll back its DEI initiatives last year, has announced that the boycott is over. #JamalBryant #Target #NekimaLevyArmstrong

item.title: NBA cancels promotion linked to Atlanta strip club after criticism from Spurs' Luke Kornet
item.description: The NBA has canceled a planned Atlanta Hawks promotion linked to a popular strip club following criticism from San Antonio Spurs center Luke Kornet. #NBA #Atlanta #Texas

item.title: Ongoing US military investigation indicates Iranian girls’ school was mistakenly marked as military target
item.description: The U.S. military may have been responsible for the strike on a girls’ school in southern Iran on Feb. 28 that killed at least 175 people, most of them children, the regime claimed. This is according to an ongoing military investigation that was cited by several American news outlets, including CNN and The New York Times. #Iran #Israel #girlsschool #ShajarahTayyebehElementarySchool

item.title: Man pleads guilty to threatening to blow up Catholic cathedral in DC
item.description: A New Jersey man has pleaded guilty to attempting to blow up a Catholic Church during a high-profile mass that takes place every year and now faces the prospect of decades behind bars. #JeanniePirro #RedMass #CatholicChurch #Washington #DC

item.title: ODU shooting: Suspect shouted ‘Allahu Akbar,’ had ISIS conviction
item.description: Before opening fire in a classroom at Old Dominion University in Virginia on Thursday, a 36-year-old man, identified as Mohamed Bailor Jalloh, a former Army National Guard soldier previously convicted of supporting the Islamic State group, shouted “Allahu Akbar.” One person was killed and two others were wounded before students subdued him, and the shooter also died. #ODUShooting #Terrorism #AllahuAkbar #ArmyNationalGuard #ROTC

item.title: Passing freedom to Gen Alpha: 1 million US Constitutions for students
item.description: This year, they are working with 25,000 principals across the nation to distribute 1,000,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution. #Constitution #ConstitutionDay #civics
